This area's contract, from [Repo layout](../../docs/contributing/repo-layout.md#area-contracts).

- **Owns:** the mod: the host check [DR-76], wiring, pane, band, fallback panes, `/room`, tools, action tokens, guards (touch set, stores, the user-level config and the mod's own `$.store`, the plugin's own files, files sent off the machine, person-only commands, the implementer's clones and approved commands, the curator's two calls), broker, agents and their usage, the implementer's installs and observed steps [DR-64, DR-75, DR-87, DR-88].
- **May depend on:** `@planroom/contract`, `@planroom/ui`, the `claude-code` mod types, its `host_types` [DR-81], and its `third_party` list: `@noble/curves`, which signs person tokens [DR-82].
- **Must not:** `@planroom/canvas`; the DOM or Node APIs; `import()`; anything that changes by turn in the composed prompt section.
- **How to test it:** `cargo xtask test --ts packages/mod` (vitest, the pure logic); `cargo xtask test` (`claude plugin test target/mod-test`, the generated harness, on all four surfaces with golden CLI outputs [DR-81]); eslint, with `no-misused-promises` off for `src/register.tsx` and `plugin-tests/` only, since the rule took 11 minutes over the mod API types and `tsc -b` still checks them [DR-81].

## Layout

- `src/`: the mod: `register.tsx`, which wires it to the host, then the engine resolver, the watch loop, the pane, `/room`, the tools, the guards, the actor and the person key, each with its vitest file.
- `plugin-tests/`: the `claude plugin test` specs, which `cargo xtask test` bundles into `target/mod-test/`, and `host.ts`, the host state they share.
- `vendor/`: `claude-code.d.ts`, the mod API types of the pinned Claude Code [DR-81].

## The host, as the walking skeleton found it

These are the facts of Claude Code 2.1.310's mod host that broke the mod once, each found only in a live session. Their home is [WS8](../../docs/contributing/research/ws8-install.md).

- The mod finds its own files through `$.plugin.root`; the host doesn't set `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` for a mod (A-14). The host's version is `$.session.version()`, not an environment variable (A-19).
- `crypto.subtle` has only `digest`, so person tokens sign with `@noble/curves` (A-17, [DR-82](../../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-82-what-the-walking-skeletons-serve-canvas-and-mod-work-settled)). Their bytes must match `kernel::keys::person_token_message`; a test on each side pins the same example.
- The host keeps `$.store` at `<config>/plugins/store/planroom_*.json`, which the guard denies to agents (A-15).
- A refused `$.command.register` skips the whole `session.start`, so no skill may share a name with a mod command ([DR-84](../../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-84-the-umbrella-skill-is-planroom-so-the-mod-can-own-room)).
- `ArtifactData` returns rows in its text block; the structured `data` comes back empty ([DR-83](../../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-83-what-the-walking-skeletons-gates-remote-slice-and-platform-checks-settled)).
- `claude plugin test` mocks the environment and command registration, so a change to start-up or the resolver path isn't proven until the bundle has run live, loaded from the dev-mods folder.
